description: Discovered by real People.merge_persons regression while validating replica-owner presentation. Merging away a Person with a Replicated transcript raises Ecto.ConstraintError transcripts_owner_person_id_fkey from PersonMerger deletion. Current merge coordination handles legacy conversations/ratings but not transcript ownership. Needs explicit history ownership/collision policy preserving canonical UUIDs, placements, access and immutable source scope; do not disable constraints or fake old-owner fixtures. Reproduce with current API capture, then merge owner into another Person. Separate from name/link projection and generic Jido ratings. Existing owner remains resolvable; merged historical aliases are projection-only.
title: [zaq-emb.27] Define Person merge handling for transcript owners
